display_name: Apnea-Hypopnea Index (NREM): (Apneas with >= 4% oxygen desaturation and with or without arousal + hypopneas with > 30% flow reduction and >= 4% oxygen desaturation and with or without arousal) / hour of NREM sleep from type I polysomnography
description: Calculated - RDI in NREM sleep (>= 4% desaturation)
calculation: 60*(hnrbp4 + hnrop4 + canbp4 + canop4 + oanbp4 + oanop4 + manrbp4 + manrop4)/(slpprdp - minremp)
